title: Document summariser
description: Ranks the sentences of a document by how central their words are and keeps the best few in their original order, so every line of the summary is a real sentence from the source.

sample_input.document: Nexura runs agents with approval gates. Approval gates pause the run until a person decides. The run keeps every step in its trace. Lunch was at noon.

runs.name: the summary keeps the central sentences

input.document: Nexura runs agents with approval gates. Approval gates pause the run until a person decides. The run keeps every step in its trace. Lunch was at noon.
